description:
Use this when you need an organic, freeform, or swept shape — a body shell, panel, fairing, ergonomic curve, lens, or sculpted form — authored as a NURBS Surface into the user's .kcad.ts, OR when you need to finish surfaces into a watertight solid or taper faces for moldability. One authoring/finishing path, selected by `kind`:
- 'nurbs' — insert a nurbsSurface(...) / surfaceFromCurves(...) call. Pass either { controls, degree, weights?, knots?, periodic? } for direct construction, OR { section_sketch_ids } for skinning. Weights are honored: supply rational weights to build exact circles/cylinders/spheres/conics (the surface becomes rational); omit weights for a non-rational surface.
- 'patchFamily' — insert a nurbsPatchFamily(...) solid built from degree-5+ shared-knot NURBS caps. Pass { controls, degree, split_direction, extrusion, split_knot? }. This requests G4 only at the two internal NURBS cap seams; evaluation reports the measured class per seam, and does not label a seam G4 unless the D0–D4 instrument passes.
- 'planeBlend' — insert planeBlendSurface(railA, railB, { normalA, normalB, handleLengthMm? }) for two corresponding, equally oriented, straight parallel rails on planar supports. This is a separate G2 blend construction, not an OCCT fillet. Pass rail_a_binding / rail_b_binding (declared Curve3D variables) and unit support normals. Sew the returned patch with both support surfaces; the measured achieved class belongs to those joined seams.
- 'boundary' — insert a surfaceFromBoundary([c1,c2,c3,c4], opts?) call: one NURBS face through 4 boundary Curve3D refs (bottom, right, top, left in loop order; adjacent endpoints must coincide within 1e-6 mm).
- 'trim' — insert a `<surface>.trimTo(<by>)` or `<surface>.split(<by>)` call. Pass `surface_binding` (the Surface variable name), `by_binding` (the cutter Surface variable name; Shape/Curve3D cutters are deferred to a later slice), and `op: 'trim'` (keep the largest imprinted piece) or `op: 'split'` (return both halves as a `[Surface, Surface]` tuple).
- 'sew' — insert a `sew([s0, s1, ...], opts?)` call to stitch N surfaces. Pass `surface_bindings` (array of Surface variable names). Optional `continuity: 'G0'|'G1'|'G2'|'G3'|'G4'` asks the lowerer to measure every shared seam and report the achieved class; G3/G4 use common-UV NURBS jets, and a missed request produces a warning. `tolerance` defaults to 1e-6 mm; `require_closed` errors if the result is not watertight.
- 'draft' — insert a `<shape>.draft(angleDeg, { face, neutralPlane?, pullDir? })` call to taper the selected face(s) for mold release. Pass `shape_binding`, `angle_deg` (0–90), and `face` (canonical name, label, or FaceQuery descriptor). Lowering emits feature.draft.failed on invalid geometry.
The returned Surface produces no Shape until you chain .thicken(t) or .toShape() (do that via add_feature on the binding name). Returns the modified code + diagnostics. Each kind fails closed on its own missing required params.

angle_deg.description: kind:'draft' — draft angle in degrees [0, 90]. The face is tapered outward by this angle relative to the pull direction.

binding_name.description: JS const name for the new binding (kind:'nurbs' default surface_<N>; kind:'patchFamily' default patch_family_<N>; kind:'planeBlend' default plane_blend_<N>; kind:'boundary' default _surface_<N>; kind:'trim' default _trimmed_<N>; kind:'sew' default _sewn_<N>; kind:'draft' default _drafted_<N>).

by_binding.description: kind:'trim' — JS variable name of the cutter Surface (must be declared in source). Shape/Curve3D cutters are deferred.

continuity.description: kind:'boundary' — C0 only; C1/C2 fail because no neighboring support surfaces are supplied. kind:'sew' — minimum measured continuity for every shared seam ('G0' | 'G1' | 'G2' | 'G3' | 'G4'); G3/G4 require common-UV NURBS faces and the lowerer reports the achieved class.

controls.description: kind:'nurbs' or 'patchFamily' — control-point grid (controls[u][v] = [x, y, z], mm). patchFamily uses degree-5+ caps and a simple internal knot.

curve_bindings.description: kind:'boundary' — tuple of 4 existing Curve3D variable names (bottom, right, top, left) declared earlier in the source.

degree.description: kind:'nurbs' or 'patchFamily' — degrees in U and V; patchFamily requires degree >= 5 in split_direction and enough controls for a simple internal knot.

extrusion.description: kind:'patchFamily' — finite non-zero translation [x, y, z] in mm from the first NURBS cap to the opposite cap.

face.description: kind:'draft' — face selector for the face(s) to taper. Accepts a canonical name (top/bottom/front/back/left/right), a user label declared via faceLabels, or a FaceQuery descriptor string.

face_tolerance.description: kind:'patchFamily' — positive OCCT face-construction tolerance in mm (default 1e-6).

handle_length_mm.description: kind:'planeBlend' — positive quintic control-handle length in mm; default is one tenth of the rail gap.

kind.description: Which surface-construction or surface-finishing path to use: 'nurbs' | 'patchFamily' | 'planeBlend' | 'boundary' | 'trim' | 'sew' | 'draft'.

knots.description: kind:'nurbs' or 'patchFamily' — optional explicit knot vectors; missing => clamped uniform inferred. patchFamily split_knot must select a simple interior knot.

neutral_plane.description: kind:'draft' — parting-line face (the plane where drafted faces remain fixed). Defaults to `face` if omitted.

normal_a.description: kind:'planeBlend' — unit normal of the first planar support face.

normal_b.description: kind:'planeBlend' — unit normal of the second planar support face.

op.description: kind:'trim' — 'trim' discards the smaller half (calls .trimTo()); 'split' retains both halves (calls .split()).

periodic.description: kind:'nurbs' — optional periodic flags per parametric direction.

pull_dir.description: kind:'draft' — demoulding direction as [x, y, z]. Defaults to the face normal at lower time.

rail_a_binding.description: kind:'planeBlend' — existing Curve3D variable name for the first straight support rail.

rail_b_binding.description: kind:'planeBlend' — existing Curve3D variable name for the second corresponding, parallel support rail.

require_closed.description: kind:'sew' — when true the lowerer emits feature.surface-sew.open-shell if the stitched result is not a watertight solid.

sampling.description: kind:'boundary' — points sampled along each boundary (default 15).

section_sketch_ids.description: kind:'nurbs' — existing sketch FeatureIds (2 or more) to skin a surface through, in order.

shape_binding.description: kind:'draft' — JS variable name of the Shape to taper (must be declared in source).

split_direction.description: kind:'patchFamily' — parameter direction for the shared simple interior knot and measured target seam.

split_knot.description: kind:'patchFamily' — optional knot value to split at; defaults to the first simple interior knot.

surface_binding.description: kind:'trim' — JS variable name of the Surface to trim/split (must be declared in source).

surface_bindings.description: kind:'sew' — JS variable names of the surfaces to stitch into a solid (each must be declared in source).

tolerance.description: kind:'sew' — edge-merging tolerance in mm (default 1e-6). Edges within this distance are merged.

weights.description: kind:'nurbs' or 'patchFamily' — optional positive rational weights, same grid shape as controls.

name: add_surface
